task_queue_debug.title: Task Queue Debug
task_queue_debug.description: Turns on verbose logging for background task processing. Helps diagnose issues with stuck or failed tasks by showing detailed queue activity in the service logs.

indexer_tasks_enabled.title: Indexer Tasks
indexer_tasks_enabled.description: Controls whether this worker processes background jobs such as datasource indexing, embedding generation, and scheduled tasks. Disable to temporarily stop all background processing on this node.
